# header: node_count leaf_switch_count spine_switch_count link_count
# next line: leaf switch node IDs
# next line: spine switch node IDs
# link rows: src_node dst_node bandwidth latency error_rate
# Paired-spine single-link expansion of clos_2dc_64_long_topo_mul.txt:
# - leaves 64-65 are DC0; leaves 66-67 are DC1
# - spines 68-75 are DC0; spines 76-83 are DC1
# - each local leaf connects to all 8 spines in its DC with one 400Gbps link
# - inter-DC spines are one-to-one pairs: 68-76, 69-77, ..., 75-83
# - inter-DC links use 800Gbps so 8 paired links preserve the original 6.4Tbps aggregate
